jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has the most services and more features within those services, than any other cloud provider – from infrastructure technologies like compute, storage, and databases – to emerging technologies, such as machine learning and artificial intelligence, data lakes and analytics, and Internet of Things. AWS Platform is the glue that holds the AWS ecosystem together. Whether t's Identity features such as access management and sign on, cryptography, console, builder & developer tools, and even projects like automating all of our contractual billing systems, AWS Platform is always innovating with the customer in mind. The AWS Platform team sustains over 750 million transactions per second. This role sits within the Payments and Fraud Prevention (P&FP) organization, whose vision is to make AWS the easiest and most trusted cloud to adopt and pay for, anywhere in the world. We deliver this through a reinforcing cycle: expanding customer access to drive adoption and revenue, empowering our internal teams, reinvesting in AI and automation for smarter fraud detection, and protecting the business in a way that enhances customer trust. This role is central to the "protect the business" pillar — keeping AWS safe to transact on while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers make billions of transactions worldwide on our cloud. They are harnessing the power of AWS to enable innovative applications, websites, and businesses. However, there are always a few people that try to take unfair advantage of a good thing. Are you interested in taking your skills and career to the next level, while having fun and fighting fraud in the cloud? Join a growing world-class team that conducts investigations in order to prevent malicious and fraudulent usage on AWS. You will lead a team of investigators, analysts, and specialists conducting complex investigations of fraud activity, while setting the strategic direction for how your team detects and prevents emerging fraud threats to AWS. You will drive related intelligence initiatives, shape investigative strategy, and stay at the forefront of trends and fraud issues impacting the cloud industry to ensure AWS is leading the curve in identifying, mitigating, and preventing fraud attacks. As a Manager - Risk Investigations, you will manage a team of Investigation Specialists (and their leads), setting the vision, direction, and culture of the team by managing individual and team performance expectations and goals, providing coaching and one-on-ones focused on making our platforms safer to transact, improving customer satisfaction, monitoring real-time service levels and schedule adherence, and serving as an escalation point. Beyond running your own team, you will define long-term operational direction in areas of ambiguity, and influence and partner cross-functionally with AWS Payment and Fraud Prevention (P&FP) leaders, engineering, science, and Investigation Managers around the globe to ensure global operations run effectively and efficiently. This position is full-time and may require shift work, including the possibility of working weekends. Key job responsibilities - Set the strategic direction and long-term vision for your investigations team, driving initiatives in areas where the path forward is ambiguous. - Analyze, meet, and report on goals aligned to customer experience improvement, fraud operating-expense reduction, and service levels. - Review and analyze performance metrics to identify areas of opportunity that drive performance improvement. - Deliver business impact and contributions to AWS through quality, productivity, and customer-experience improvements. - Demonstrate excellent time-management skills and the ability to work independently in situations with a high level of ambiguity. - Develop the careers and skills of investigators by hiring the best, providing effective coaching, identifying growth opportunities, and implementing supplemental training. - Identify the business impact of trends and make data-based decisions. - Manage workflow, handle escalations, and proactively engage resources to address issues or challenges. - Influence and collaborate cross-functionally with partner teams (P&FP, engineering, science, and global Investigation Managers) to shape and deliver program-level goals beyond your immediate team. - Support hiring needs for the team and the broader organization. - Plan and execute activities that recognize, motivate, and develop your team.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

About the Role:
Anthropic's Global Safety, Intelligence, and Security (GSIS) organization is seeking a highly experienced Physical Security Design Lead and Contract Document Specialist to join the Global Design Engineering Construction (DEC) team. In this role you will author and continuously enhance the contract document basis of design (BOD) and the reusable design templates (drawings, specifications, schedules, and ancillary documents) that drive the consistency and quality of contract documents across Anthropic's global office facility build program. You will serve as the technical authority for access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance, intercommunications, radio, and network systems within the contract document set, working in close partnership with GSIS partners, Real Estate / Workplace, the Network Team, and other cross-functional stakeholders. You will gather lessons from every phase of the project lifecycle, from site/risk assessment through construction, handover, and post-occupancy audits and incident reports, and feed them back into the design documentation, using automations and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate the pace of documentation updates.
Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and continuously enhance the contract document basis of design (BOD), initiating BOD content from the site/risk assessment and programming efforts produced at each project kickoff
Author and evolve design templates (drawings, specifications, equipment schedules, riser diagrams, and ancillary documents) for access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance, intercommunications, radio, and network systems, including variations that comply with international / regional standards and codes
Serve as the contract-document subject matter expert: review design consultant deliverables (SD/DD/CD/RIBA stage packages, specifications, equipment schedules) for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with the BOD, and drive coordination across architectural, electrical / fire alarm, network, AV, and Real Estate / Workplace disciplines
Support bid, construction, and operational handover phases through specification clarifications, RFI responses, submittal review, shop-drawing back-checks, and ensuring closeout documentation and as-builts remain consistent with the issued contract documents
Partner with GSIS (Sec Ops, Regional Security Managers, Investigations, Global Security Technology Lead), Real Estate / Workplace, the Network Team, design consultants, and security integrators to capture operational needs, site constraints, and lessons learned from every project phase and translate them into BOD and template revisions
Maintain the GSIS design library (template drawing sets, master specifications, equipment schedules, standard details) under version control, along with change-management, exception, and tracking logs, and provide regular status updates and improvement recommendations to the Physical Security DEC Manager
Implement automations and AI-assisted workflows, BIM add-ins, web-based utilities, and data-processing tools that streamline repetitive design and documentation tasks, and align QA tools and global standards across business units while documenting regional variances

Have a minimum of 6+ years of design engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of contract document development for physical security and/or low-voltage systems
Hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field
Have core technical expertise in access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance, intercommunications, radio, and network systems, and can author specifications, drawings, and equipment schedules from scratch
Have a strong understanding of A/E deliverables and phases (SD/DD/CD, RIBA Stages), CSI-format specifications, equipment schedules, and construction administration submittal processes
